description: This file contains the implementation of the CatalogItemService class, which provides CRUD operations and listing functionalities for catalog items in a Blazor web application. It interacts with external data services, performs HTTP requests, and manages catalog item data including brand and type information.

classes.name: CatalogItemService
classes.description: Implements ICatalogItemService; provides methods to create, edit, delete, retrieve, and list catalog items, interfacing with external services and APIs.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new catalog item via an HTTP POST request and returns the created CatalogItem.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Updates an existing catalog item via an HTTP PUT request and returns the updated CatalogItem.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a catalog item by ID via an HTTP DELETE request and returns the status message.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a catalog item by ID, fetching related brand and type names, and returns the complete CatalogItem.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Fetches a paged list of catalog items, enriching each with brand and type names.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Fetches a complete list of catalog items, enriching each with brand and type names.
